title: Injection Moulding Production Manager
description:
**Job Description – Injection Moulding Production Manager**

We are hiring an experienced Injection Moulding Production Manager for handling overall production operations in plastic manufacturing.

Responsibilities:

* Manage Injection Moulding, Blow Moulding & Assembly operations
* Plan and monitor daily production targets
* Ensure product quality and minimum rejection
* Handle manpower, machine utilization & production efficiency
* Coordinate with maintenance, quality & dispatch teams
* Maintain production reports and shift planning
* Ensure safety and process discipline on shop floor

Requirements:

* Strong knowledge of Injection Moulding, Blow Moulding & Assembly
* Candidate must be from Preform, Cap & Closure, or Packaging Container industry background
* Experience in production planning and team handling
* Ability to solve production and quality issues efficiently
* Good leadership and communication skills

Pay: ₹55,000.00 - ₹60,000.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* Do you have experience In Pet Blowing, Pet Preform And Injection Moulding
* How much Experience do you have in plastic Injection moulding ?

Work Location: In person
